title: AnkiLabs - Search & PostgreSQL
description: AnkiLabs lookup stages, connection pools, search row counts and read-only PostgreSQL health. No query text or statement statistics are collected.

panels.title: Sentence stage mean duration by outcome
panels.description: Average duration of each sentence-lookup stage by outcome over 15 minutes. Stages overlap, so never add them into a request total; read them with the sample counts beside.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, outcome) (increase(ankilabs_sentence_lookup_stage_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="ankilabs"}[15m])) / sum by (stage, outcome) (increase(ankilabs_sentence_lookup_stage_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[15m]))

panels.title: Sentence stage sample count / 15 minutes (including errors)
panels.description: Sentence-lookup stage observations over 15 minutes, including errors. A mean from a handful of samples is anecdotal; an error outcome points at the failing stage.

panels.title: Dictionary stage mean duration by outcome
panels.description: Average duration of each dictionary-lookup stage (query, resolve, translate, notes) by outcome over 15 minutes. Stages overlap; do not add them up.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, outcome) (increase(ankilabs_dictionary_lookup_stage_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="ankilabs"}[15m])) / sum by (stage, outcome) (increase(ankilabs_dictionary_lookup_stage_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[15m]))

panels.title: Dictionary stage sample count / 15 minutes (including errors)
panels.description: Dictionary-lookup stage observations over 15 minutes, including errors. Use them to judge how far the means beside can be trusted.

panels.title: Sentence DB pool: separate states, per pod
panels.description: Sentence-lookup connection pool per pod: size, available, waiting and max are separate states, not additive. Waiters for 3 minutes fire LookupPoolWaiting.

panels.title: Dictionary DB pool: separate states, per pod
panels.description: Dictionary-lookup connection pool per pod: separate states, not additive. Waiters mean requests are queuing for a database connection (LookupPoolWaiting).

panels.title: Mean rows observed per search phase
panels.description: Average rows per search phase over 15 minutes; candidate, matched and returned are distinct phases and not every request reaches each. These are observations, not SQL execution plans.

panels.title: Search row histogram sample count / 15 minutes
panels.description: Searches observed per phase over 15 minutes. Use it to judge how many searches the mean rows beside represent.

panels.title: Search row distribution: cumulative observations by bucket / 15 minutes
panels.description: Cumulative buckets, including zero and +Inf. These are sample counts, not a row-rate or percentile.

panels.title: PostgreSQL connection and collector health: 1 success, 0 failure
panels.description: pg_up and every enabled collector: 1 success, 0 failure. A reachable exporter can still fail collectors (for example without the monitoring login), so check both.

panels.title: PostgreSQL client connections by state and wait type
panels.description: Client connections to the ankilabs database by state and wait type. Many idle-in-transaction or lock waits point at stuck requests; compare with the lookup pools.

panels.title: Oldest observed PostgreSQL transaction by state
panels.description: Age of the oldest open transaction per state. A steadily growing value, especially idle in transaction, means a session holds a transaction open; find its PID in the PostgreSQL logs.

panels.title: Database backends and configured server-wide connection ceiling
panels.description: The ceiling includes reserved/server-wide capacity. This is not a claim that all connections are available to lookups.

panels.title: PostgreSQL commits and rollbacks / 15 minutes
panels.description: A rollback is not necessarily a user-visible error. Correlate with request outcomes and SQLSTATE.

panels.title: PostgreSQL 18 checkpoints / 15 minutes
panels.description: Uses pg_stat_checkpointer (PostgreSQL 17+), not removed checkpoint fields in pg_stat_bgwriter.

panels.title: PostgreSQL PVC used / capacity
panels.description: Kubelet-reported used and capacity bytes of data-postgres-0. On openebs-hostpath both may be the whole node filesystem; Platform - Storage has the authoritative view.

panels.title: PostgreSQL locks by mode (not blocked-request counts)
panels.description: Locks held in the ankilabs database by mode. These are held locks, not blocked requests; check the oldest transaction and wait types when they climb.

panels.title: Lookup breadcrumbs by request ID / fingerprint
panels.description: Sentence and dictionary lookup events filtered by the request_id and fingerprint variables (parsed at query time, never indexed). Started events show the last stage reached when a process died.

panels.title: PostgreSQL stderr: native severity, normalized level and raw fallback
panels.description: EOF with an open transaction retains pg_severity=LOG and gets level=WARNING. PID is query-time only; correlate within a narrow time range because PIDs can be reused.
